rag.text:
Test: TC-3461 — Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Display - Task Reference - Gantt module
Priority: Medium | Status: In Progress | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-66 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: teamspace

Description:
New Data type - Task Reference. On Front-end is visible as Parent (column in Column View). It is different from Parent Link which is Labels Data Type.
Reason: Technical change of Atlassian Cloud API https://community.developer.atlassian.com/t/deprecation-of-the-epic-link-parent-link-and-other-related-fields-in-rest-apis-and-webhooks/54048. 

Steps:
1. On Atlassian Cloud navigate to Gantt module of boxName and check if columnView is selected
   Data: boxName: TC-3461 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Display - Task Reference - Gantt module

columnView: TC3461 with Parent
   Expected: WBS and Gantt chart are displayed.

"TC3461 with Parent" column view is selected. FolLowing columns are visible:
- Icon
- Key
- Summary
- Parent

Project "TC-3461 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Display - Task Reference - Gantt module" is visible. FolLowing tasks are displayed:
- Epic parent
-- Task child
-- Story child
-- Bug child
2. Check columnView field value
   Data: columnView: TC3461 with Parent
   Expected: For epic children: Task child, Story child and Bug child Parent field value is: "Epic parent"
3. Click on taskChild Parent fieldValue.
   Data: taskChild: Task child
fieldValue: Epic Parent
   Expected: Jira page for Epic Parent is open in new tab
